text:
maria: Quick sync: putting together the release notes for next docs publish. Scope: patch notes, migration steps v0.9->v1.0, SDK snippet parity (node/python), and a link-image fix pass.

nick: I ran a link audit and found ~14 links pointing to old-host.example.com plus three image 404s under /integrations. I'll open redirect PRs for the high-traffic ones.

lina: I'll take the image fixes. Two were due to asset renames in the design repo; can we add stable asset paths?

maria: Yes, prefer /static/assets/vX/ paths so we can add redirects when we change names. Add a note in the release doc about rewritten asset URLs.

aj: I'll convert the streaming JS example to a server-side snippet (CommonJS and ESM) and add a short note about using client.stream() with an AbortController for long-running streams.

devon: I'll mirror those in Python (async and sync). Also will document the tokenization tweak in 1.0 that affects chunked prompts.

docs-bot: lint: docs build flagged 1 unclosed code block (integrations/s3.md) and 2 broken image refs (/deploy/private/img1.png, /guides/setup/img2.png).

nick: The S3 doc fence is a quick fix. I'll open a tiny PR. For the images, Lina can either re-upload or add redirects.

lina: Re-uploading new asset names now; will post mapping in the PR.

maria: For changelog entries use the template at /docs/release-notes/template.md. Each entry needs: short blurb, user impact, migration steps (if breaking), and a known-issue tag when relevant.

ops-bot: incident-log: dedicated-coldstart (2026-03-21) referenced. Workaround: warm-up traffic; tracking issue infra/1234.

maria: Add a known-issue entry: "Dedicated capacity cold-starts after kernel invalidation" with the workaround and link to infra/1234.

devon: One SDK rename to flag: client.create_stream -> client.stream in node SDK. We should include a tiny snippet showing both old and new usage for migration.

aj: I'll add a side-by-side example and note about deprecation warnings.

nick: Redirects PR opened for 6 pages, pinging reviewers. I'll include canonical meta tags on the new pages.

maria: Timeline: aim to have PRs open by EOD, review queue tomorrow morning, merge before docs deploy at 10am PT. I'll draft the two release blurbs (stream stability & routing fallback tweak) and drop them into the release-notes draft for review.

lina: One small request: call out the sample snippets' source-of-truth path. I'd prefer /samples/snippets in this repo to avoid cross-repo drift.

devon: Agree. Will reference /samples/snippets in the migration steps.

maria: Thanks all. Please tag the PRs with 'relnotes-draft' so I can grab them into the notes. Will run a final linkcheck after merges.

ops-bot: reminder: run linkcheck after deploy (job: infra/linkcheck-postdeploy).
